title: Network Professional | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: Network Professional. Category: Networking. Duration: 6 months. Description: CCNA + CCNP. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city.
